method: Built the comparison with three_way.py (A = labeller C, E = evidence inventory as the second opinion): 12 accepted, 24 disputes. Adjudicated each dispute from the drawing, not by majority: zoomed renders (0.25 m grid) of every spot and deduplicated prims.pkl queries (layer, linetype, exact end points) of the walls, columns, WIN/WALL-GL/D-JAMB/DOOR/I-DOOR, FUR, TREE, FLOOR, ROOF and A_Grill entities, plus the ground-floor plan under the staff block and the east and west elevations (results/map_elevations.json). Kept the 12 accepted openings; nothing in the drawing contradicts them. Main calls: (1) Measurement as in the u-west key: a and b on the wall centre line at the structural wall-end faces (frames inside the opening), D-JAMB cladding ignored. So the suite windows go on x 112.0946 / 106.2946 and the north facade on y 23.2338, not on the frame lines the inventory used; UE-24 and UE-26 keep A's ends (the inventory's ends overran the column / jamb); UE-23 is measured between the WALL ends (2.50 m). (2) The north-facade hinged glazed leaves (UE-03/05/06/07) are casement windows: glass and frame lines across the opening in the closed position, outward sashes over a 0.30 m ledge with an upstand and no floor beyond; interior doors here have no lines across. eitherKind is for sliding/fixed glazing the plan cannot settle, so it is not set. (3) The staff-corridor south glazing is fixed glazing set between the lobby wall end, a column and the yard-wall stub, so two windows (UE-12, UE-11); the inventory's single 12.5 m band was the grille line and is rejected; the grilles go to glassWalls as screens. (4) Passage mouths (a wall end facing the side of a perpendicular wall) are optional: UE-19, UE-21, UE-25, UE-29, UE-31, UE-32, as is the 0.20 m court slot UE-04 and the grille-screened yard sides UE-09/UE-10 (same as the accepted UE-08). The inventory's two passages on x 116.22 are the sides of a cabinet alcove and a wash niche formed by stubs, so rejected. (5) UE-23, the open bay in the screen wall, is a real opening (gap in one wall line, marked open full height in the elevation): passage, not optional. Final check: a sweep of every WIN, WALL-GL, D-JAMB, DOOR, I-DOOR and A_Grill primitive and every door-size arc in the box (each lies within 0.35 m of a final opening or glass wall, or is explained: cladding outlines, the u-west lobby window UW-14, door-leaf tips of UE-14/UE-15, a basin block on WIN, a fixture block on DOOR, furniture), a wall-gap scan of the WALL/COL lines (nothing new), and marked renders of the whole part (check_final.png, check_west.png, check_east.png); no opening was missed by all opinions. Scorer note: tools/score.py crashes (TypeError) when a matched detection has the wrong class and the key opening has no eitherKind field, because c_ok becomes None; wrapping that expression in bool() fixes it. Scoring A and the inventory against this key (with that workaround) gives A 22/22 right and the inventory 15/22.
